_comment: Manual triage overrides for round-trip failures the stdlib classifier in classify_failures.py cannot route by string patterns alone (they need RDKit canonicalization: @-stereo where atom order also changed, RAW-unparseable aromatics, eta-slot placement on automorphic rings). Molecule -> defect class (must exist in SESSION_OF). classify_failures.py applies these AFTER automatic classification, for failed rows only. Append new hand-triaged cases here.
_comment_winding: A differing winding multiset is NOT automatically a notation bug. Since the encoder canonicalizes winding on eta rings that can be turned over onto themselves (v0.3.6), any winding difference that survives is a real coordinated-face difference. QOFTOU_comp_0 is such a case: MetalloGen builds its ansa-bis(indenyl) zirconocene as rac or meso non-deterministically across runs, so the classifier's winding_flip pattern misroutes it to S4. It is a generator stereochemistry defect.
